hotel.name: Shilla Stay Mapo

amenities.name: Fitness Center with Gym / Workout Room

hotel.description: Shilla Stay Mapo Located near Gongdeok Subway Station, Shilla Stay Mapo provides easy access to airports: 50 minutes away from Incheon International Airport and 15 minutes away from Gimpo International Airport. You can travel non-stop from the airport to the hotel via the Airport Railroad. Close to four railroad and subway lines (Airport Railroad, Gyeonggui Line, Subway Lines 5 and 6) and other public transportation, Shilla Stay Mapo boasts optimal transport to various urban attractions as well as suburban areas in Gyeonggi Province, such as Ilsan and Paju. Located only a 6-minute drive away from Seoul World Cup Stadium, a venue for various international sports events and K-pop concerts such as the Big Bang Concert and Dream Concert, it is the best choice for enjoying Hallyu (Korean wave) cultural sightseeing. Shilla Stay Mapo operates a total of 383 guest rooms and facilities, including the Lobby, Meeting Room, Business Corner, Buffet Restaurant and Fitness Center. The Cafe, a buffet restaurant located on the 2nd floor, features a seating capacity of 114 and serves breakfast and lunch buffets.
